SELECT
  TO_CHAR(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS order_date,
  ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS total_sales
FROM
  orders o
JOIN
  order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC
LIMIT 25;
